title: accept: request
description: Apply a worktree run's captured diff to the theatre's working tree, unstaged, all or nothing, then remove its worktree. A request never names a path, a diff or a workspace.

run.description: The run, by id or unique prefix.

reason.description: Why, in the person's words, recorded in lineage. Absent: none was given.

rehearse.description: Change nothing: check that the diff applies cleanly, and report the files it would change. Absent means false.
